def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Only use a divider color when it forms full lines in both directions.
    line_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in horizontal] + [grid[0][c] for c in vertical]
    sep = max(set(line_colors), key=line_colors.count)
    horizontal = [r for r in horizontal if grid[r][0] == sep]
    vertical = [c for c in vertical if grid[0][c] == sep]
    row_edges = [-1] + horizontal + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + vertical + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_edges) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_edges) - 1)]
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_spans for r in range(r0, r1)
             for c0, c1 in col_spans for c in range(c0, c1)]
    background = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in row_spans for c0, c1 in col_spans]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(grid[r][c] != background
                                           for r in range(p[0], p[1])
                                           for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    pattern = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = pattern[dr][:c1-c0]
    return out
